name: Byteon
description: Byteon is an AI-powered visual novel platform that guides first-time hackathon participants through an interactive, story-driven experience. It combines real-time chatbot support and generative AI to make learning, building, and competing in hackathons more accessible and engaging.

paragraphs: Byteon is a full-stack SaaS platform designed to help aspiring hackathon participants learn, develop ideas, and confidently participate in innovation-driven events. Inspired by visual novels and interactive learning experiences, Byteon transforms the often-overwhelming hackathon journey into an approachable, guided experience.

The platform combines interactive educational modules, AI-powered ideation, curated learning resources, and conversational assistance to help users understand hackathons, explore project ideas, and prepare for their next innovation challenge.
features: How to Hackathon: A visual-novel-style learning experience divided into five chapters.
True or False Flashcards: Reinforce hackathon knowledge through interactive questions.
Multiple-Choice Quizzes: Test understanding of essential hackathon concepts.
Progress Tracking: Keep track of learning progress throughout the interactive experience.
IdeateAI: Helps users explore, develop, and refine potential project ideas.
